integrity: The proof separates the cited convergence and square-summability facts from the new coordinatewise contradiction argument. Finite numerical experiments were not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Diagonal positive-definite quadratics only; no closed form for the limiting metric, no nondiagonal/composite/stochastic/nonconvex extension, and no claim that the half-threshold is attained or globally sharp.
title: AdaGrad-Diff self-tunes into the classical stability interval on separable quadratics
